cohort: 318 mother-newborn pairs following emergency cesarean delivery in Northwest Ethiopia.
finding: Advanced maternal age (>35 years), maternal danger signs during pregnancy, and non-reassuring fetal heart rate were identified as significant risk factors for adverse early neonatal outcomes following emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age, pregnancy complications, and non-reassuring fetal heart rate increase the risk of adverse neonatal outcomes specifically following emergency cesarean section.
